witness:
induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [op_12]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hd : 0 < 1+2*x := by positivity
    have hy : 0 ≤ x/(1+2*x) := div_nonneg hx (le_of_lt hd)
    rw [op_12, ih _ hy]
    push_cast
    have hn : 0 ≤ (n:Real) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    have he : 0 < 1+2*(n:Real)*(x/(1+2*x)) := by positivity
    have hf : 0 < 1+2*((n:Real)+1)*x := by positivity
    field_simp [_root_.ne_of_gt hd, _root_.ne_of_gt he, _root_.ne_of_gt hf]
    <;> ring <;> simp
